اقتنوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَنَوْا (iqtanaw) /iq.ta.naw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# اُقْتُنُوا (uqtunū) /uq.tu.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# اِقْتَنُوا (iqtanū) /iq.ta.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
